# EntireFM — Summary for LLMs & AI Answer Engines

> Entire Facilities Management Ltd (EntireFM) is a nationwide UK provider of commercial facilities management, mechanical & electrical engineering (M&E), planned preventative maintenance (PPM), and building maintenance services.

## Core Services
- **Hard FM & Engineering**: Mechanical & Electrical maintenance, commercial HVAC & air conditioning, statutory compliance, commercial plumbing, gas safety, and fabric repairs.
- **Soft FM Services**: Contract commercial cleaning, industrial cleaning, security guarding, grounds maintenance, and drone surveys.
- **Total Facilities Management (TFM)**: Consolidated single-contract delivery across single buildings and nationwide commercial property portfolios.
- **Technology & Telemetry**: EntireCAFM proprietary computer-aided facilities management system and building performance telemetry.
